name: epoch
description: Epoch workspace for core SDK, CLI, and WASM hosts.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @epoch/core && npm run build -w @epoch/git-proxy && npm run build -w @epoch/atproto && npm run build -w @epoch/identity-bridge && npm run build -w @epoch/cli && npm run build -w @epoch/wasm && npm run build -w @epoch/wasm-react && npm run build -w @epoch/integration-core && npm run build -w @epoch/live && npm run build -w @epoch/live-react && npm run build -w @epoch/live-redux && npm run build -w @epoch/live-yjs && npm run build -w @epoch/react && npm run build -w @epoch/gen-ui && npm run build -w @epoch/redux && npm run build -w @epoch/xstate && npm run build -w @epoch/platform-core && npm run build -w @epoch/platform-sdk && npm run build -w @epoch/platform-web && npm run build -w @epoch/design-tokens && npm run build -w @epoch/community-core && npm run build -w @epoch/community-api && npm run build -w @epoch/community-web && npm run build -w @epoch/community-operations-web && npm run build -w @epoch/community-cli && npm run build -w @epoch/sample-hello-world-cli && npm run build -w @epoch/sample-self-evolving-canvas && npm run build -w @epoch/sample-self-evolving-dashboard && npm run build -w @epoch/sample-epoch-live-collab && tsgo -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @epoch/core && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/git-proxy && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/atproto && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/identity-bridge && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/cli && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/wasm && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/wasm-react && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/integration-core && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/live && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/live-react && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/live-redux && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/live-yjs && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/react && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/gen-ui && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/redux && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/xstate && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/platform-core && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/platform-sdk && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/platform-web && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/design-tokens && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/community-core && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/community-api && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/community-web && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/community-operations-web && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/community-cli && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/sample-hello-world-cli && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/sample-self-evolving-canvas && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/sample-self-evolving-dashboard && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/sample-epoch-live-collab && tsgo -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.gate:fast: npm run konsistent && npm run docs:check && npm run design:lint && npm run design:audit && npm run lint
scripts.gate:push: npm run gate:fast && npm run typecheck && npm run build -- --pretty false && npm run test:unit:runtime
scripts.features: npm run build -- --pretty false && npm run test:features:runtime
scripts.test:unit:nightboard-parity: npm run build -w @epoch/community-core && npm run build -w @epoch/community-api && tsgo -p tsconfig.test.json && node dist/test/run-nightboard-parity-tests.js
scripts.test:pact:consumer: npm run build -- --pretty false && node dist/test/pact/run-pact-consumer.js
scripts.test:pact:provider: npm run build -- --pretty false && node dist/test/pact/run-pact-provider.js
scripts.test:pact: npm run build -- --pretty false && node dist/test/pact/run-pact-tests.js
scripts.test:runtime: npm run test:unit:runtime && npm run test:features:runtime
scripts.coverage: npm run build -- --pretty false && c8 npm run test:runtime
scripts.test: npm run build -- --pretty false && npm run test:runtime
scripts.verify: npm run docs:check && npm run lint && npm run lint:nightboard-a11y && npm run design:lint && npm run design:audit && npm run typecheck && npm run konsistent && npm test && npm run a11y:community-web && npm run a11y:nightboard && npm run coverage && npm run test:pact && npm run nightboard:parity && npm run nightboard:faults && npm run nightboard:e2e
scripts.nightboard:parity: npm run nightboard:build:check && npm run test:unit:nightboard-parity && node docs/design-explorations/nightboard/navigation-projection.test.mjs && node scripts/verify-nightboard-parity.mjs && NB_E2E=NAV- node docs/design-explorations/nightboard/e2e.mjs
